transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because no matter what anyone says, I know some people at work are secretly working together to set me up, and nobody seems to take that seriously. It is incredibly frustrating because I am just trying to do my job, but everyone else keeps brushing it off as nothing.
Have you heard any unusual voices or seen things that other people can't hear or see, or is this situation mostly about what you've noticed these people doing?

No, I'm not hearing voices or seeing things, and I'm certainly not crazy. This is about real, concrete actions—like certain drivers and maintenance guys deliberately leaving things off paperwork and coordinating mistakes to make my inspections look bad so they can frame me.
Besides the frustration with your coworkers, how has your overall mood been lately? Have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or lost interest in things you normally enjoy?

My overall mood is actually fine, and I haven't lost interest in the things I enjoy. I still get up on time, pay my bills, and hang out with my brothers on weekends like I always have. I only feel worked up or frustrated when I'm dealing with this setup at work.

Have you had similar experiences of people trying to betray or undermine you in other areas of your life, like with friends, family, or past jobs, or is this strictly limited to your current workplace?

No, this is strictly limited to my current job, and it only started about a year ago. My relationships with my family, like my brothers, and my friends are completely normal, and I've never had any issues like this at past jobs. It is just this specific group of people at my current workplace.
To help me rule out other potential causes, are you currently taking any prescription medications, or do you regularly use alcohol or recreational substances?
No, I'm not taking any prescription medications at all. I also don't drink alcohol or use any kind of recreational substances.
